issue_context.title: Style/SafeNavigation autocorrect removes comments
issue_context.body:
## Expected behavior

When rewriting code to replace `if` statements with safe navigation, I expect comments to remain intact.

## Actual behavior

Comments within the `if` statement are removed.

## Steps to reproduce the problem
```ruby
if wal
  # Description of what happens here
  wal.release(lock)
end
```
autocorrects to
```ruby
wal&.release(lock)
```
rather than
```ruby
# Description of what happens here
wal&.release(lock)
```

## RuboCop version
```
0.69.0 (using Parser 2.6.2.0, running on ruby 2.4.5 x86_64-darwin17)
```

review_comments:
Hmm, indent seems to be broken when used in a method.

```diff
diff --git a/spec/rubocop/cop/style/safe_navigation_spec.rb b/spec/rubocop/cop/style/safe_navigation_spec.rb
index 2c142df19..10697d908 100644
--- a/spec/rubocop/cop/style/safe_navigation_spec.rb
+++ b/spec/rubocop/cop/style/safe_navigation_spec.rb
@@ -935,17 +935,21 @@ RSpec.describe RuboCop::Cop::Style::SafeNavigation, :config do

         it 'does not lose comments within if expression' do
           new_source = autocorrect_source(<<~RUBY)
-            if #{variable}
-              # this is a comment
-              # another comment
-              #{variable}.bar
+            def foo
+              if #{variable}
+                # this is a comment
+                # another comment
+                #{variable}.bar
+              end
             end
           RUBY

           expected_source = <<~RUBY
-            # this is a comment
-            # another comment
-            #{variable}&.bar
+            def foo
+              # this is a comment
+              # another comment
+              #{variable}&.bar
+            end
           RUBY
           expect(new_source).to eq(expected_source)
         end
```

```console
% bundle exec rspec spec/rubocop/cop/style/safe_navigation_spec.rb

(snip)

Failures:

  1) RuboCop::Cop::Style::SafeNavigation auto-correct behaves like all variable types if expression does not lose comments within if expression
     Failure/Error: expect(new_source).to eq(expected_source)

       expected: "def foo\n  # this is a comment\n  # another comment\n  FOO::BAR&.bar\nend\n"
            got: "def foo\n  # this is a comment\n# another comment\nFOO::BAR&.bar\nend\n"

       (compared using ==)

       Diff:
       @@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
        def foo
          # this is a comment
       -  # another comment
       -  FOO::BAR&.bar
       +# another comment
       +FOO::BAR&.bar
        end

     Shared Example Group: "all variable types" called from ./spec/rubocop/cop/style/safe_navigation_spec.rb:1193
     # ./spec/rubocop/cop/style/safe_navigation_spec.rb:954:in `block (5 levels) in <top (required)>'
```
I think that's acceptable. Some of the `Layout` cops will fix the indentation in the auto-correct loop.
I get it. @jonas054's opinion is excellent.
This seems to insert all the comments from the complete file, no matter where they are located.

You're absolutely right! This is something we all missed. Thanks for the heads-up.

@tejasbubane Can you take a look?
The problem is reported in #7397 and fixed in #7420.
